lines.zh: 我用两条后腿走，尾巴平举。
lines.en: I walk on two hind legs, tail held out straight.

lines.zh: 我踩过沼泽，脚下往下陷。
lines.en: I cross the marsh and my feet sink.
My stride is long. I can run you down.

lines.zh: 我沿着水边找落脚的地方。
lines.en: I follow the waterline looking for footing.

lines.zh: 我的前肢短，走路时收着。
lines.en: My forelimbs are short and held close.

lines.zh: 林子和沼泽之间，是我的路。
lines.en: The ground between wood and marsh is my road.

lines.zh: 我看一眼地，再看一眼前面。
lines.en: I glance at the ground, then ahead.
I put a foot through a rotted log.

lines.zh: 钦利组的两大掠食者，我是其一。
lines.en: One of the Chinle's two great predators.
The water smell here is heavy.
I step across a shallow ditch.
My shadow crosses first, then I do.
I climb the earth slope.
My claws dig into the mud.
I stand with my tail moving slowly.
I open my mouth and the scents come in.
Something is bubbling in the marsh.

lines.zh: 我在泥里蹲下，压低身子。
lines.en: I crouch in the mud, keeping low.

lines.zh: 我的头一动不动，眼睛在动。
lines.en: My head is still. My eyes move.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水汽蒙在我眼上。
lines.en: Marsh mist settles over my eyes.
There's a small bird over my head.
I ignore it. It doesn't come down.

lines.zh: 阳光照在我背上，纹路很清楚。
lines.en: Sun on my back shows my markings.
I keep watch at the water's edge.

lines.zh: 我踩着泥，把界线走一遍。
lines.en: I walk the mud line of my ground.
Another smell, very faint.

lines.zh: 我把重心放低了一点，准备长追。
lines.en: I lower my stance, ready for a long pursuit.
Behind the rock I wait for it to tire.
You're on my ground.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，没有低头的意思。
lines.en: I raise my head to you and don't lower it.

lines.zh: 钦利的掠食者，靠追耗死你。
lines.en: A Chinle predator—I wear you down on the run.
I'll run you tired, then bite.

lines.zh: 你站上风处，我闻得到你。
lines.en: You stand upwind, and I can smell you.

lines.zh: 你退到水那边，我就让你走。
lines.en: Get back past the water and I'll let you go.
I'm a frightening sight, aren't I.
I tilt my head and weigh you up.
Your smell is unfamiliar.
I don't keep guests here.
If you stand firm, I'll stand firm.
Let's see who moves first.
The bite landed on the back of my neck.
I sidestep and steady.
Blood drips on the mud and soaks in.
I run long, and still get bitten.
I whip my tail to press the pain down.

lines.zh: 后腿挨了一下，步子发飘。
lines.en: A hit on my hind leg and my steps wander.
I retreat to the water's edge. Better footing.
Mud in the wound makes it worse.
I growl low, a warning.
Move again and I bite.
Meat, and fresh.

lines.zh: 你手上那块肉还带着血。
lines.en: That meat in your hand is still bloody.
I take one step that way.
Let it go — now.
I won't eat you. Only that.
That smell reminds me of prey.
Lower it a bit. I can't see.

lines.zh: 那块肉的味道盖过沼泽的腥。
lines.en: That meat smells over the swamp's own stink.
I go around and come at it from the side.
After this, you'll still be you.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的胸口，弹回去。
lines.en: You hit my chest and rebound.
I brace with my tail and stay up.
That should hurt your shoulder.
I step back and water splashes.
My claws are beside your feet.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖磕上我的肋骨。
lines.en: Your knee knocks into my ribs.
The shove turns me half a step.

lines.zh: 钦利组的泥，被我们踩烂。
lines.en: We churned the Chinle mud to slurry.

lines.zh: 你比我矮，撞不到我的头。
lines.en: You're shorter; you can't reach my head.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我往前挪了一格。
lines.en: When you step back, I move up a block.
My kind is across the marsh.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此走了一圈。
lines.en: We circle each other once.
Its markings are darker than mine.

lines.zh: 我们把头低下来，碰了碰。
lines.en: We lower our heads and touch.

lines.zh: 巢会做在干一点的高地上。
lines.en: The nest will be on drier high ground.
The eggs go in the soil, warmed by the ground.

lines.zh: 我们两个，一个守一个睡。
lines.en: One of us guards while the other sleeps.
If something comes near, I bellow.
When the young hatch, I'll shield them.
This ground is for them.
I take its hind leg and shake.
That will hold me a while.

lines.zh: 我把肉撕成两条，先吞一条。
lines.en: I tear the meat in two and swallow one piece.

lines.zh: 这个我先叼到芦苇后面。
lines.en: I carry this behind the reeds first.
I tear it open and eat slowly.
I gnaw the bones too.
Not enough.
I carry it to the water's edge.

lines.zh: 肉汁滴进泥里，我舔干净。
lines.en: Juice drips into the mud and I lick it up.

lines.zh: 吃完我把嘴在草上擦了。
lines.en: Afterward I wipe my mouth on the grass.
Something's moving past the reeds.
I raise my head, nose working first.
It's alive. It'll run.
Upwind, the smell reaches me first.
I take the upwind position.
At this distance I'll catch it.
I chase slowly, but I don't let go.
My tail has straightened out.
It raises its head and moves.
I kick off the ground after it.
I stretch out and run it down.
It's a little faster than me.
But it can't keep it up.
It runs into the shallows and I wait.
I follow without rushing the bite.
It turns into the trees; so do I.
It's running for the marsh. Worse for it.
The mud will drag at its legs.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴垂下去，低了半寸。
lines.en: Its tail drops half an inch.
I'm breathing lighter than it is.
I've closed the gap.
A Chinle hunter wears prey down.
That glance slowed it by half a beat.
Ten more strides and it's mine.
Eight. Its legs are slowing.

lines.zh: 它往深处跑，那里水更冷。
lines.en: It's heading deep, where the water runs colder.
It stumbled.
It's in the mud now.
I drive off my hind legs and spring.
I bite in at an angle on its flank.
I pin it with a foreclaw, then bite.
That brought it down.
I wrench my head and tear it open.
It bites me back.

lines.zh: 我扫尾，把它绊倒在浅水。
lines.en: I sweep my tail and trip it in the shallows.
We roll into the mud.
I hold it down and don't let go.
It goes slack in my jaws.
I lift my head, panting.
Nothing else around.
I lower my head and open the hide first.
Halfway through, I look up.
This is mine.
I rise at the marsh's edge.
Soft mud underfoot, shallow water.
Triassic light was whiter than this.
First I test the footing.
One tail sweep throws water.
This place smells of me now.
There are other animals far off.
I raise my head so they know.
There's shade over in the woodland.

lines.zh: 我两条后腿踩着沼泽，先陷下去。
lines.en: My hind legs press into the swamp and sink.
My claws still carry old mud.
This marsh can feed me.
I walk from the water up to high ground.
Only once I'm planted do I feel sure.
The quiet here is a lie.

lines.zh: 我知道，我很快会打破它。
lines.en: I know. I'll break it soon enough.
First, somewhere to lie low.
That hollow is the place to lie up.

lines.zh: 火燎到我背上，我冲进沼泽。
lines.en: Fire catches my back and I plunge into the marsh.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔进泥里，闷响一声。
lines.en: I fall from height into mud with a dull crash.

lines.zh: 泥水漫过我的鼻子，我抬不起头。
lines.en: Muddy water covers my snout and I can't lift my head.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，我被掀进水里。
lines.en: A blast throws me into the water.

lines.zh: 箭从侧面扎进我的肋骨。
lines.en: An arrow comes in from the side into my ribs.

lines.zh: 一股力压住我的腿，动不了。
lines.en: A force presses my legs down.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽空了，我饿得发抖。
lines.en: The marsh is empty and hunger makes me shake.

lines.zh: 雷打在我头顶，整条脊背都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits above me and my whole spine goes numb.

lines.zh: 没有泥，没有水，我一直在掉。
lines.en: No mud, no water. I keep falling.
